inputs: All scenario changed paths, exactly as frozen; no path is withheld.
output_normalization: Test-file paths emitted by Vitest are mapped to frozen catalog check IDs.
empty_selection: An empty native test-file set is preserved as empty, not rewritten.
failure_behavior: Nonzero selector execution, unknown output paths, or version drift invalidate the arm result.
limitations: Vitest related selection uses static import relationships and documents limitations around dynamic imports.
The native arm selects tests only and makes no claim about format, typecheck, lint, or build checks.
The benchmark does not deliberately alter Vitest configuration to improve or worsen its result.
